I am 67 years old. I never went to school. I learned farming from my mother and from watching others in this village. I have farmed for 46 years. My family has 10.9 mu of land, just me and my husband now. We grow cotton. That is what this land has always grown.

This year I will do the same as last year. Last year my cotton gave about 500 jin of seed cotton per mu. That is enough to live on. I use the improved seeds that Old Wang from the east end buys. His cotton is always tall and green. I need about one and a half bags of seed for my whole field.

For fertilizer, I put one full bag of compound fertilizer on every mu at planting time. That is a 50-jin bag. Everyone around here does that. Then when the cotton starts flowering in July, I spread half a bag of urea on each mu — 25 jin per mu. I know fertilizer is expensive. Last year I spent almost 2,000 yuan on fertilizer for my whole field. But I would rather put too much than too little. If the crop fails because I was cheap, that is a disaster. Wasting a little fertilizer is just money gone. I watch what my neighbors buy. This year they are buying the same as last year, so I will too.

I water from my well four times. First when I plant in April. Second when the flowers come in July. Third when the bolls are getting fat in August. Fourth in late August if the weather is dry. If it rains good, maybe I skip one, but usually I water four times.

Cotton always has bugs. The bollworm comes every year. I spray seven times. I buy the medicine from the shop in town. I spray when I see holes in the leaves, or when my neighbor sprays. If I wait too long, the worms eat everything.

I till the field with the rotary tiller in spring. I do not plow deep. Just turn the top soil so the seeds can go in easy.

I expect about 500 jin of seed cotton per mu this year, same as last year. If the rain is good and the bugs are light, maybe 550 jin. But I count on 500 so I am not disappointed. I do not try new things. Last year worked. Change is risky.
